about:
A&H Manufacturing Worldwide, based in Johnston, Rhode Island, traces its roots to 1967 when jewelry salesman H. Jack Feibelman invented the hanging jewelry card, a design that became an industry standard. The company remained under Feibelman family leadership until 2022, when ownership transitioned to the Calandrelli family—Anthony and Daniel Calandrelli—who bring decades of packaging experience and continue the founder's legacy of customer-focused innovation.

The company designs, engineers, and manufactures custom product packaging across four facilities worldwide. Its capabilities span carding, hang tags and tickets, boxes, labels, e-commerce packaging, molded specialty items, gift packaging, eco-friendly solutions, puff pads, and pouches. In-house design, engineering, and research teams handle projects from concept through production and delivery, serving both large retailers and smaller brands.

A&H serves a diverse client base that includes the world's largest retailers as well as businesses in jewelry, apparel, accessories, tools, hardware, and wine. The firm's packaging solutions are tailored to each product category, with an emphasis on brand storytelling and functional fit.

Feibelman's original insight—"When you can't find what you're looking for, you invent it"—still drives the company's approach. A&H differentiates itself through Made-in-USA production that reduces transportation emissions, a sustainability program that re-engineers packages to use less material, and a customer service model built on timely communication and creative problem-solving.
